finalText:
Build's clean now — exit code 0, `0 errors`.

The dependency bump changed two contracts and left two call sites behind:

- `src/core/options.js:6` — new bundler passes `{ retryCount }` instead of `{ retries }`; code still read `options.retries` (undefined), crashing on `.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`; the strict boolean check threw on anything but literal `true`/`false`. Added an `undefined` → `false` case.

Everything else in the log (the ~950 lines of `DEP0xxx`/`WARN Wxxx`/dedupe noise) is harmless deprecation chatter from the bump — 8 warnings still print, but they're informational, not blocking.
